subject: gk
question: Which of the following best describes the purpose of the National Single Window System (NSWS) portal launched by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry?

options.text: To streamline pension disbursal mechanisms for unorganized workers
To facilitate industrial clearances and approvals through a single digital platform
To monitor school enrollments across states using Aadhaar linkage
To centralize water quality testing across urban and rural regions

solution:
The correct answer is __**To facilitate industrial clearances and approvals through a single digital platform**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Single Window System (NSWS) is a **digital platform** aimed at simplifying and expediting the process of obtaining regulatory approvals and clearances for businesses in India.
 
• It provides a **single-window clearance mechanism** for investors and businesses, enabling seamless interaction with various government departments.
 
• NSWS integrates **over 32 central departments and 15 state governments** to provide a unified platform for industrial approvals, avoiding duplication and reducing paperwork.
 
• The platform is designed to boost the ease of doing business in India by making the approval process more **efficient, transparent, and faster**.
 
• Launched in **September 2021** by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, the system is a **key initiative under the 'Make in India' and 'Digital India' campaigns**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Schemes like the **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana (PM-SYM)**, which ensures old-age protection for unorganized workers.
 
• PM-SYM is implemented through the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) and provides a minimum monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after the age of 60.
 
• Educational enrollment and Aadhaar linkage fall under programs like the **Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan** or initiatives led by the Ministry of Education.
 
• The NSWS focuses exclusively on industrial clearances and does not handle educational or Aadhaar-related tasks.
 
• Water quality testing and monitoring are undertaken by initiatives like the **Jal Jeevan Mission**, which ensures safe drinking water supply to rural households.
 
• The Ministry of Jal Shakti oversees such programs, which are distinct from the objectives of the NSWS.
